source_status_note: World Bible-derived campaign seed reconciled to the shared 365-day SV calendar; explicit opening-relative birth_day remains arithmetic authority and birth_date_sv is derived from it.

locations.name: White Laurel Heights
locations.notes: Rich mountain ground; one of the reasons the sect exists where it does. The best portions have limited capacity and increasingly restricted access.

locations.name: Stillwater
locations.notes: Old stable ancestral ground. Valuable for sustained disciplined cultivation rather than sheer density.

locations.name: Bell Hollow
locations.notes: Broad moderate-to-rich basin capable of supporting many disciples; helps explain Grey Bell’s scale as a teaching institution.

locations.name: Stonepool
locations.notes: Smaller and denser ancestral ground; naturally produces more restricted high-value access.

locations.name: Brackwater Springs
locations.notes: Several useful concentrations distributed through the district rather than one sacred chamber.

locations.name: Deepwell Basin
locations.notes: Broad reliable ground; timed access can be bought, awarded, sponsored, or granted. Common high-end tournament reward.

locations.name: Clearwell
locations.notes: Weaker but dependable site held commercially; access sold to people lacking institutional ground. Exact owner remains open.

locations.name: Stonewake Caverns
locations.notes: Remote cavern network with rich scattered chambers; difficult to occupy permanently and surrounded by uncertain reports.

locations.name: Redroot Vale
locations.notes: Major Vein-Root environment involving landholders, refiners, merchants, institutions, and Imperial interests.

locations.name: Ashgrave Wells
locations.notes: Surviving and damaged remnants of former cultivation infrastructure; some recover, some remain broken, some are contested.

locations.name: Silent Peak
locations.notes: Low-density but exceptionally stable current. Ordeal cultivation, sealcraft, and Groundbinding rather than rich ordinary cultivation.

locations.name: Founder’s Cut
locations.notes: Physical trace of an extraordinary old feat; an Enlightenment Trace rather than a power-up location.

locations.name: The Long Stair
locations.notes: Old mountain route culturally associated with endurance, travelling challengers, and martial pilgrimage.

locations.name: The Red Yard
locations.notes: Famous permanent challenge ground where circuit fighters, wanderers, and spectators intersect.

locations.name: Seven Bridges
locations.notes: Old recurring river tournament and one of the River Circuit’s iconic events.

locations.name: Oldstone Hall
locations.notes: Archive/manual authentication centre tied to scholars, historians, legitimate copies, and provenance disputes.
